Thanks Marissa — confirmed for Mon Mar 22, 10am PT. A few quick technical notes to include in the runbook:
- Pre-cutover: we need a brief performance smoke test against a staging snapshot (15 minutes) - who will trigger? Recommend Acme engineer (Raj) with SE oversight.
- Cutover steps: stop writes to old endpoint -> switch DNS loadbalancer weights -> warm caches for top prefixes -> monitor 95th latency and error rate for 10 minutes
- Rollback policy: if 95th latency increases >350ms or error rate >2% sustained for 5 minutes, we rollback to previous variant and open a postmortem
- Fallback: we’ll keep a conservative model variant (v1.4-quant) as a fallback in the same region. If capacity constrained, automatic routing will send traffic to fallback and notify on-call.
- Need a test account (API key) in production with limited quota for SE smoke tests - can procurement/ops provision this by EOD Fri?

I’ll draft the technical section and drop it in the shared doc.

—Aditya
